description: email.rs handle_email_query: when client omits 'limit' the handler defaults to 256 (line 181-191), but the response JSON (lines 306-319) never includes a 'limit' field. RFC 8620 §5.5: 'This is only returned if the server set a limit or used a different limit than that given in the request.' When client sends no limit and server applies 256, or when client sends limit>256 and server clamps to 256, the response MUST include limit:256. The field is entirely absent from the response construction.
title: Email/query missing 'limit' in response when server applies default
